Name: JP's Utility Machines - Crop Compactor - Mobile Greenhouse
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i][u][center]Compact Crop Core[/center][/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Save space by placing several seeds inside the machine and, in due time, you will have all the production in your hands![/b][/size][/color]



[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Robin's store you will find available for purchase 5 new machines that can help you a lot with space saving. These machines have capacities from 3 to 100 seeds, [color=#00ff00]they also act as greenhouses, so you can place any seed in any season and you will get all your production![/color][/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Crops that are harvested once (parsnips, beets, etc.) take the same amount of time to mature and produce their yield as they would if they were still in the soil. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Crops that continue to produce after the first harvest will take a few more days to produce their yield, but will produce a full month's worth of produce. [color=#00ff00]Days to Grow + (Days to Grow / Regrow Days)[/color][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Consideration is given to whether the plant can produce several products at once (e.g., cranberries). The amount of extra production is also chosen at random. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]No watering or care is required for crows, but they cannot be fertilized to speed up the process, and no crops obtained will be of silver quality or higher. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][b][i][color=#ffff00][size=5]The machines do not have that strange movement effect, but every so often an animation and sound will occur to let you know that they are in operation. [/size][/color][/i][/b]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Now it also works with seeds from other mods![/size][/color][/b][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The mechanics are very limited, so I did what I could with these aspects, trying to keep the game as balanced as possible. [/size][/font]
[/list]
[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=5]In the Requirements section, I will leave another mod that will be useful for removing the seeds you place in the machines, otherwise you could lose them if you break the machine!!! 

[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[i][color=#ff0000][size=5]In theory that's it, the machines have special behavior with the Millennial Fruit and any mod crop that takes longer than 28 days and continues to produce over time. I hope you enjoy this Utility Machine.[/size][/color][/i]
[b][i][size=6][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]
Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
